Ohn'iri Springs is the main seat of power for Clan Ohn'ir, one of the four major clans of Maruuk Centaur living in the Ohn'ahran Plains.
Old Engy Salteye is a goblin located in the Incontinental Hotel in the Undermine.
Old-Blood Hielaman drops from The Coaglamation in the City of Threads.
Old Lady Greasewheel is a goblin located near the Incontinental Hotel in the Undermine.

Old Man Lowe is a goblin located in the Vatworks in Undermine. He has spent his life building something that'll solve his people's problems; to this end, he made the Goblin Optimal Livability Enhancement Machine, or G.O.L.E.M. for short. His son, Pitz, on the other hand, doesn't have an inventor's bone in his body, to the old man's dismay, but still tried to help his father and his neighbors in his own way. When the G.O.L.E.M. was ready for a test run, Old Man Lowe didn't trust Pitz to look over G.O.L.E.M. by himself, and so he asked adventurers to accompany G.O.L.E.M. and Pitz to make sure nothing went wrong. Despite some initial success, G.O.L.E.M. started malfunctioning. Pitz tried to fix
Oil of Heartwood is a crafting reagent used to complete the Midnight Alchemy abilities Recycle Flasks and Recycle Potions. It is sold by the following vendors for .

The Ominous Portal spawned during the Hearthstone's 10th Anniversary event in Durotar, Stormwind City, and Valdrakken with a timer of 5 minutes, after which Whizbang appeared, tossing cards and summoning elite mobs that represent Hearthstone card characters. Whizbang summons the following enemies each encounter: *Chillwind Yeti or Boulderfist Ogre *Patches *Dr. Boom **Boom Bots
Old V'k is a nerubian spiderlord located in the Burrows in the City of Threads. He works as an undertaker in the shop Crypt Lords.
Wind-Up is an ability used by various pets during a Pet Battle.

Om'resh is a broker who appears in Eco-Dome: Rhovan in K'aresh. Om'resh was working at the eco-dome with Om'bera as a team for thousands of years, when a meteor destroyed his home, so he and Om'bera tried to salvage what they could, including taking animals and plants, and fled with the other brokers, but Om'bera was separated when they were beset by scavengers of the Great Dark Beyond. The brokers were soon found by Locus-Walker, Xal'atath, and adventurers. In order to find Om'bera and the remaining equipment, Om'resh tasked adventurers with slaying the invasive creatures, while he and Locus-Walker went back to find Om'bera. They found her items, and then Om'bera herself, dead, slain by the
Om'Dodaf is a broker flight master located in Hosaas' Rest in K'aresh.

Omnium Folio is an arcane folio that contains powerful runes usable in combat. Once the Sunstrider Omnium is unlocked, the folio is available as a minimap button or via the /run ToggleExpansionLandingPage(12) macro.

Onu, Ancient of Lore is a leader family in Warcraft Rumble. Though slow, Onu is an extremely difficult to remove hero with an immensely high health pool. His Safe Arbor ability effectively makes him a mobile troop transport -- making any ground Onu makes along the path a constant pushing point for the player.
Onyx Wall is an ability used by various pets during a Pet Battle.
Orb Fragments the remains of the destroyed Althalaxx Orb. They are provided for Return to Delgren.

The Opulent Nexus is an area located in Tazavesh, the Veiled Market. It is a massive private dock run by Cartel So. This serves as the area where So'leah uses her plunder to ascend. By the time of war on K'aresh, the docks had become open to all under the K'aresh Trust. While the area is no longer listed as the Opulent Nexus, the massive set of portals still remains. The main portal is now used to transport players to and from Dornogal to Tazavesh -- acting as the primary entrance point for the city.
Operation: Floodgate: Disposing of the Garbage is the standard breadcrumb to Operation: Floodgate, started by Paks Topskimmer, the concierge of the Incontinental Hotel in Undermine.
Oppressive Orator's Larynx drops from Orator Krix'vizk in the City of Threads.

The Orbs of Ascendance are summoned in groups of 10 by Xal'atath every minute while Xal'atath's Bargain: Ascendant is the active affix. Players will need to stop the Cosmic Ascension cast by interrupting, knockback, crowd controlling, or destroying them.
Open Tome of Twilight Nihilism is housing decor that can be purchased for from Solelo in Stormwind City or Lonalo in Orgrimmar.

The Orecreg is a mine on the southwestern coast of Isle of Dorn. The Unbound of Freywold Village used to mine here, but fungarians have taken over. The surface of the mine leads to the Gemvein Tunnels. Players are initially directed here on A Natural Remedy and Building Blocks. Some Discarded Botanist Notes inside a building starts Concerning Fungarians. Nearby, the Orecreg's Doglegs skyriding race is at on the shoreline to the west, Dhar Oztan and the Tranquil Strand are across the plains to the north, Freywold Village and the Earthcrawl Mines delve are just to the east, and Dhar Durgaz is atop the mountain to the southeast.
Orida is an earthen caretaker found atop the mountainside southwest of Dornogal where she can be seen taking care of the tribute stones and the shutdown earthen found in that place.

The Order of the Cloud Serpent Flight Log teaches the Cloud Serpent Riding. It can be purchased from a Order of the Cloud Serpent vendor after reaching for . This item will allow alts to obtain the skill without having to reach status themselves.
__NOTOC__ Oshigol is a rare elite mountain giant that patrols outside of Maruukai to the north in the Ohn'ahran Plains.
Ossein Champions are Maldraxxi skeletons located at the Temple of Courage in Bastion. They can be seen on top of Flayedwing Wraiths flying above the temple.

Ornate Silvermoon Candelabra is housing decor obtained from the quest Lightbloom Looming. Additional copies can be purchased for 250 Voidlight Marl from Sathren Azuredawn at Saltheril's Haven in Eversong Woods.
Ott Breath is an ability used by various companions during a Pet Battle.
Otter Breath is an ability used by various companions during a Pet Battle.
Ottest Breath is an ability used by various companions during a Pet Battle.
Outlandish Lumberjack is a housing achievement earned by collecting 250 Olemba Lumber. This achievement unlocks the ability to gather Olemba Lumber without dismounting.
Outland Milling is a Milling ability granted to scribes with Outland proficiency Inscription. It is automatically added upon learning Outland Inscription.
Outland Prospecting is the :prospecting ability for Outland Jewelcrafting. It is automatically learned upon learning Outland Jewelcrafting.
Overload Elemental Herb is an ability available to Herbalists who has a single rank in the Dragon Isles "Mastering the Elements" rank.
The Overload Elemental Deposit is an ability available to miners who has a single rank in the Dragon Isles "Mastering the Elements" rank.

The Override Sequence is an ability added to the spellbook after completing the 9 o'clock pillar and obtaining the Keys to Incognitro, the Indecipherable Felcycle. To use it, the player will need to mount on the bike.

The Overly-Sealed Letter appears at at the Incontinental Hotel in Undermine after defeating Chrome King Gallywix for Liberation of Undermine: The House Loses in Liberation of Undermine. It starts Diversified Investments (quest), unlocking the Darkfuse Solutions faction of the Cartels of Undermine.

Overcharged Titan Consoles are located in six Overcharged Delves at the entrance and at the respawn stone: *Kriegval's Rest *Skittering Breach *The Spiral Weave *Nightfall Sanctum *Fungal Folly *Sidestreet Sluice Dagran Thaurissan II is remotely controlling them from Delver's Headquarters in Dornogal and has players interact with them in several quests, starting with Titan Consoles. Purchasing all seventeen upgrades awards Titan Console Overcharged, which grants the OC91 Chariot ironstrider flying mount. In The War Within Season 3 and beyond, the chariot is available for purchase from Sir Finley Mrrgglton for 15,000 Undercoin.
Overlook Zo'shuul is a small island in northwestern K'aresh. It serves as the Phase Diving and Reshii Wraps hub, with the Untethered Coin and Ethereal Strands vendors present.
Overload Infused Deposit is an ability available to Miners which is automatically learned upon reaching skill level 5 in Midnight Mining.

The Overcharged Proto-Drake is a proto-dragon that spawns at the Wild Preserve on the Waking Shores during Grand Hunts. It will fly in, and then Degmakh will land on it, causing the proto-dragon to explode.
Overload Ore is a collection of "Overload Deposit" spells from the mining profession. *Overload Elemental Deposit *Overload Empowered Deposit *Overload Infused Deposit
Overload Herbs is a collection of "Overload Herb" spells from the herbalism profession. *Overload Elemental Herb *Overload Empowered Herb *Overload Infused Herb
Overload Infused Herb is an ability available to Herbalists who have unlocked the "Midnight Overload" section in Midnight Herbalism.
Pa'chek's Sacrificial Altar is found on the Isle of Thunder and it needs to be destroyed as part of the daily Heinous Sacrifice. Spiritbinder Pa'chek can be found near it.
Owlbeast Pineal Glands drop from the following owlbeasts in : *Berserk Owlbeast *Crazed Owlbeast *Moontouched Owlbeast *Ragged Owlbeast *Raging Owlbeast

Ozrin the Steelweaver is an ascended nerubian located in High Hollows in the City of Threads. Despite being labeled as a Blacksmithing Trainer, the NPC does not train Blacksmithing but instead sells Blacksmithing supplies.
Pact of Exhaustion is a warlock class talent. It grants the Curse of Exhaustion ability. It will also transform Blight of Weakness into Blight of Exhaustion.
Pact of Tongues is a warlock class talent. It grants the Curse of Tongues ability. It will also transform Blight of Weakness into Blight of Tongues.
Overwhelm is an ability card from the Crown of the Heavens set.

Painkiller is a powerful defensive Klaxxi Augmentation that can periodically save adventurers from death, restoring their health and mana instead. It is granted by Korven the Prime at Klaxxi'vess in the Dread Wastes. Like all Klaxxi buffs, it remains on the adventurer indefinitely while in the zone, including upon re-entry, but is replaced if a different Augmentation is selected.
Pale Baby Vorquin are vorquin found at Camp Antonidas in the Azure Span. They're only visible after interacting with the nearby Magical Creature Manual to gain the buff.
Pale Priests are ascended nerubians located at the High Hollows in the City of Threads.
__NOTOC__ Paks Topskimmer is a goblin located in the Incontinental Hotel in the Undermine. A Trick Deck of Cards is located on the desk next to him.
Pail of Preserved Obscurity drops from the Fangs of the Queen in the City of Threads.

__NOTOC__ The Pale Huskfish is a fish that can be caught in Khaz Algar. They are almost exclusively fished in Festering Pools that appear sporadically around Khaz Algar, though they can very rarely be caught in open water. They can be opened by inquisitive anglers seeking treasure. However, these fish more often than not contain vendor trash, though they do have a rare chance of having swallowed something of interest such as Crusty Darkmoon Cards or Careless Dasher's Treasures.
Palek'ti, the Mouth of Nothingness is a cosmic worm that drops from Malek'ta near a destroyed caravan south-east of Eco-Dome: Primus on K'aresh.

Pan-Seared Mycobloom is a food item made with Khaz Algar Cooking (15). The ability to make this food can be learned from the three cooking trainers on Khaz Algar: Athodas, Treagor, and Sauciere Drook.

Pahk is the Loa of the Depths worshiped by the forest trolls. Pahk is the lord of dark oceans and rarely seen, for he swims in the deep depths. He is the keeper of the Strait of Hexx'alor separating Zul'Aman and the Coiled Isle. Many trolls of the forest tribes that seek hunt for sustenance or adventure beneath the waves often carry idols to Pahk close by.
Pan-GO-lin Time is a delve power obtained by looting the "Pan-GO-lin Time" object which spawns after defeating the Paingolin in delves.
The Paingolin is a pango located in delves as a Strange Disturbance during Midnight Season 1. Killing it will spawn an egg that contains the Pan-GO-lin Time delve power.
Pallga is a skitterling located in the Umbral Bazaar in the City of Threads.

The Pantheon of Order, also known as the Titan Pantheon or simply the Pantheon, are a group of titans who shaped and ordered worlds while watching over the Great Dark Beyond and searching for others of their kind. They created the titan-forged, various races of Azeroth, and empowered the Dragon Aspects through the titanic keepers. The entire Pantheon was defeated in a battle with their former brethren Sargeras who obliterated their physical forms. However, Norgannon cast a spell to protect their spirits and sent them hurtling towards Azeroth, where they tried to merge with the keepers. This failed as the keepers' bodies were unable to handle the titans' souls' entire might. Their spirits fad
Paranoia Mantle is crafted by Leatherworking (250); learned from speaking with the Shadowy Figure in Moonglade after completing Waking the Nightmare.
__NOTOC__ Panzor the Convincible is a stone golem vendor hammering on the Black Anvil located in Shadowforge City in Blackrock Depths.

The Pantheon of Life is one of several pantheons created by the First Ones and embody the cosmic force of Life. According to the broker Ta'lora, the Moon Goddess Elune is hypothetically a member of the Pantheon of Life, since she is the sister and counter part of the Winter Queen within the Pantheon of Death. They embody together the balance of a great cycle between Life and Death.
Parched Leechers are devourer mites found flying above the Endmire in Revendreth during Parasol Peril.
Pandaria Milling is a Milling ability granted to scribes with Pandaria proficiency Inscription. It is automatically added upon learning Pandaria Inscription.
Pandaria Prospecting is the :prospecting ability for Pandaria Jewelcrafting. It is automatically learned upon learning Pandaria Jewelcrafting.
Paralyzing Strike is an ability card from the Crown of the Heavens set.

Patch 10.2.6: Plunderstorm is the sixth medium patch for . It was released on 19 March 2024. This patch brought a new, bold, unique, limited-time event, that wasn't publicly tested on the PTR as Executive Producer Holly Longdale explained that Blizzard wanted to keep it a surprise, inspired by WoW Classics Season of Discovery. Dragonflight Season 4 went live on 23 April 2024. For Season 4's patch notes, see patch 10.2.6a.
Patch 10.2.6a is what is calling the Dragonflight Season 4 patch notes, to separate it from patch 10.2.6. It released on 23 April 2024.
Partially Teleported Murlocs are murlocs located just south of Gadgetzan in Tanaris. An Unlucky Murloc can be seen nearby, stuck halfway through objects and terrain.
Partially Teleported Gnolls are gnolls located just south of Gadgetzan in Tanaris. A number of Unlucky Gnolls can be seen nearby, stuck halfway through objects and terrain.
Partially Teleported Kobolds are kobolds located just south of Gadgetzan in Tanaris. A number of Unlucky Kobolds can be seen nearby, stuck halfway through objects and terrain.
Partially Teleported Troggs are troggs located just south of Gadgetzan in Tanaris.

Patch 11.0.7: Siren Isle is the second medium patch of The War Within. It is centered around a mysterious island called Siren Isle, once used by Kul Tiras to mine :Azerite during the Fourth War. Additional content includes a Kirin Tor epilogue story, prologue quests for patch 11.1.0, additional Human and Kul Tiran customizations, the return of the Turbulent Timeways timewalking event, and the return of Plunderstorm with some new rewards.

Patch 12.0.5: Lingering Shadows is the first medium patch of , which was released on 21 April 2026. Engage in new activities, experience more of the story in Midnight, and earn more loot as the efforts to push back the forces of the Void and their agents continue. You'll undertake new Void Assaults, disrupt powerful Ritual Sites, get a boost with Voidforge, group up for Decor Duels, and more.

Pieces of Hate are money golems located in the Arathi Highlands during Plunderstorm. Once per match, two of them will spawn in different parts of the zone, marked on the zone map with skull icons and heralded by an alert: : : Pieces of Hate drop plenty of Plunder as they fight, as well as a large Golden Chest or Magical Chest when they die. Though they have a decent amount of health, it isn't difficult to whittle one down, so long as its attacks are avoided. The real danger comes from other players, who will often come looking to take out opponents engaged with the Pieces of Hate and then kill it for themselves.
